svg.text: For fit and installation only, not for manufacture.
1. All live conductors (L and N, insulated) pass through the Ø13.5 sensor aperture; keep the passage
2. No mounting holes: hold the board by its edges (card guide or clip). Keep 3.5 mm free below
3. P1: +12 V, GND, test input and alarm output; leave 20 mm above P1 for the mating plug and wires.
4. Board has a Ø21.4 cut-out under the sensor ring. Highest part: sensor ring 13.75 above the board.
5. Outline, holes and positions from the board's CAD model; part shapes are envelopes (±0.5 mm).
